heading: Everything around the consultation.
intro: Beyond individual departments, Beacon Ridge coordinates the services that make a hospital visit actually work end to end.

services.title: Diagnostics & Imaging
services.description: On-campus lab and imaging so most results are ready the same day, feeding directly into your consultant's notes.

services.title: Pharmacy
services.description: An in-campus pharmacy that fills prescriptions written during your visit, so you don't need a separate stop.

services.title: Ambulance & Transfer
services.description: A dedicated ambulance bay for emergency arrivals and coordinated inter-hospital transfers when a case needs a different facility.

services.title: Day Care & Short-Stay
services.description: A day-care ward for procedures that don't need an overnight admission, with the same follow-up coordination as inpatient care.

services.title: Telehealth Follow-ups
services.description: Illustrative video follow-up consultations for patients who don't need to be back on campus in person.

services.title: Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation
services.description: In-house physiotherapy that picks up directly from orthopedics and neurology discharge plans.

disclaimer: Services described here are illustrative of what a Premium-tier hospital website can showcase. Beacon Ridge is a fictional hospital; no real facility, equipment or capacity is implied.
